author: Sample commentary (synthetic data)
headline: 72% of 1,860 recommendations since 2014 were implemented; the median took 17 months, and 135 recommendations issued before 2023 are still open.
paragraphs: Three bodies recommend changes to city departments: the Controller's auditors (with formal follow-up), the Budget and Legislative Analyst (for the Board of Supervisors) and the Civil Grand Jury (whose recommendations require a response under Penal Code 933 but have no enforcement). Implementation rates differ accordingly, and the source filter applies everywhere on this dashboard.

Departments agreed with 82% of Controller recommendations and 44% of Civil Grand Jury recommendations. Disagreement is legitimate; 164 recommendations were formally disagreed with, and their reasons are on the report pages.
530 recommendations repeat an earlier one on the same theme at the same department. Repeats are the strongest sign that a fix did not stick.

caveats.text: 'Implemented' is the department's own report for BLA and Civil Grand Jury recommendations; only the Controller's auditors verify implementation.
Status is as of the last follow-up; a recommendation with no follow-up since 2022 may have been implemented without anyone recording it.
